scope: Erratum only; prior frozen artifacts/manifests remain unchanged.

corrections.topic: Projection scratch versus per-request context capacity
corrections.incorrect_inference: The benchmark context capacity of 256 caused projection scratch to scale to 256 activation rows.
corrections.correction: The loopback adapter explicitly sets model max_tokens=32 while allocating each request a context capacity of 256. Projection scratch remains 1,253,376 bytes per device, exactly as at qualification. Context capacity and projection row capacity are different settings.
